steps.what: Recent and the rest two cards: between them, the table's width of the page's background, 12-16 px high; the rows on either side in the table's
steps.check: (() => { const g = document.querySelector('.olf-rows tr.olf-gap > td'), t = document.querySelector('#table'); const bg = (el) => getComputedStyle(el).backgroundColor; const page = bg(document.querySelector('.project-ds-nav-main')); const r = g.getBoundingClientRect(), tr = t.getBoundingClientRect(); const at = (y) => document.elementFromPoint(tr.left + tr.width / 2, y), cell = (y) => at(y).closest('td, th') ?? at(y); return [bg(g) === page, bg(cell(r.top - 4)) !== page, bg(cell(r.bottom + 4)) !== page, at(r.top + r.height / 2) === g, Math.round(r.height) >= 12 && Math.round(r.height) <= 16, Math.round(r.left) === Math.round(tr.left) && Math.round(r.right) === Math.round(tr.right)]; })()
